paragraphs.source_en: This was not just true in the eastern Mediterranean region.All the former great powers suffered. In Assyria, King Tukulti-​Ninurta I’s luck didn’t last. After building the Middle Assyrian Empire to its largest extent, taking over Syria and conquering Babylon, he decided that he needed a new capital city. In this, he was emulating the earlier Late Bronze Age kings Kurigalzu of Babylon, Akhenaten of Egypt, and Untash-​napirisha of Elam.
